correctness.rationale: The journal text explicitly states the two-branch formula as Theorem 2. The standard prime-power lcm formula gives \(\lambda(12)=2\) versus \(\varphi(12)=4\), and \(\lambda(24)=2\) versus \(\varphi(24)/2=4\). Exact enumeration verifies minimality in each branch. The journal proof of Lemma 3 uses only \(p-1\mid T\) after \(p\parallel n+i\); this follows directly from the correct lcm formula, so the displayed proof of Theorem 3 is unaffected.
